requirement_text: The system shall encrypt collection data and maintain checksums for verification.
user_story: As a curator, I want collection data encrypted and checksums kept for verification, so that data stays private and its integrity can be checked.
technical_task: Encrypt collection data and maintain checksums that can be used to verify it.
acceptance_criteria: Given collection data, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given collection data with a checksum, when it is verified, then the checksum confirms whether the data is unchanged.

requirement_text: Sensitive data will be encrypted before being sent over insecure connections like the internet.
user_story: As a user, I want sensitive data encrypted before it is sent over insecure connections like the internet, so that it cannot be read in transit.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data before it leaves over an insecure connection such as the internet.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the internet, when it is sent, then it is encrypted first.
Given an intercepted transmission, when it is read, then the sensitive data cannot be understood.

requirement_text: System shall provide a user interface familiar to depositors, integrating seamlessly with existing University systems.
user_story: As a depositor, I want a familiar user interface that integrates with existing University systems, so that I can deposit without learning something new.
technical_task: Design a user interface that is familiar to depositors and integrates with existing University systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a depositor, when the user opens the interface, then it follows the layout of existing University systems.
Given an existing University system, when the interface is used, then it integrates with that system.
rationale: Role stated: depositor. "Familiar" and "seamlessly" are read as following existing University conventions, which is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The system shall generate reports on storage consumption by financial contact.
user_story: As a storage administrator, I want reports on storage consumption by financial contact, so that I can see who uses what.
technical_task: Generate storage consumption reports grouped by financial contact.
acceptance_criteria: Given stored data linked to financial contacts, when a report is generated, then storage consumption is shown for each financial contact.
Given a financial contact with no stored data, when the report is generated, then its consumption is shown as none.

requirement_text: After installing the Application from iTunes or the App store the user will be asked to login.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be asked to log in after installing the application from iTunes or the App store, so that I can start using it.
technical_task: Show a login prompt the first time the application starts after it is installed from iTunes or the App store.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application was installed from iTunes or the App store, when the user starts it, then the user is asked to log in.
Given the login prompt, when the user logs in successfully, then the user can use the application.

requirement_text: The system upon detection of inactivity of an interactive session shall prevent further viewing and access to the system by that session by terminating the session or by initiating a session lock that remains in effect until the user reestablishes access using appropriate identification and authentication procedures.
requirement_text_raw: The system upon detection of inactivity of an interactive session shall prevent further viewing and access to the system by that session by terminating the session  or by initiating a session lock that remains in effect until the user reestablishes access using appropriate identification and authentication procedures.
user_story: As a security officer, I want an inactive interactive session ended or locked until the user re-authenticates, so that unattended sessions cannot be used.
technical_task: On detecting inactivity of an interactive session, either terminate the session or lock it until the user reestablishes access through identification and authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Given an interactive session with detected inactivity, when the system reacts, then the session is terminated or locked.
Given a locked session, when the user reestablishes access with appropriate identification and authentication, then the session lock is lifted.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The inactivity period is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall set the book status to Available if the book is not currently borrowed, allowing members to reserve it.
user_story: As a library member, I want a book shown as Available when it is not borrowed so that I can reserve it, so that I can plan my borrowing.
technical_task: Set the book status to Available when the book is not currently borrowed and allow members to reserve it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a book that is not currently borrowed, when its status is shown, then it is Available.
Given a book with Available status, when a member requests a reservation, then the book can be reserved.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create, join, and leave groups for shared expense management.
user_story: As a user, I want to create, join and leave groups for shared expenses, so that I can split costs with others.
technical_task: Provide group creation, joining and leaving for shared expense management.
acceptance_criteria: Given the group function, when a user creates a group, then the group is created.
Given an existing group, when a user joins or leaves it, then the membership is updated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to modify all fields of an asset except IDs, and bulk entry files can be used for modifications.
user_story: As an asset manager, I want to modify all fields of an asset except its ID, and use bulk entry files for modifications, so that I can update many assets at once.
technical_task: Allow editing of all asset fields other than the ID, including through bulk entry files.
acceptance_criteria: Given an asset, when the user modifies a field other than the ID, then the change is saved.
Given an asset, when the user tries to modify its ID, then the change is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: asset manager. The bulk entry file format is not described.

requirement_text: An LHCP chooses to view the physiologic data monitoring details.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view the physiologic data monitoring details, so that I can follow my patients' readings.
technical_task: Add a function that shows the physiologic data monitoring details to the LHCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given physiologic data being monitored, when the LHCP chooses to view the details, then the physiologic data monitoring details are shown.
Given the details are shown, when the LHCP reads them, then they correspond to the monitored data.

requirement_text: User shall operate efficiently with a minimum processor speed of 500MHz.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to run efficiently on a processor of at least 500MHz, so that it works on modest hardware.
technical_task: Support processors with a minimum speed of 500MHz.
acceptance_criteria: Given a processor with a speed of 500MHz, when the system is run, then it operates.
Given a processor faster than 500MHz, when the system is run, then it operates.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Efficiently" is not measured.

requirement_text: The sending HCP may edit the priority of the referral possibly and possibly the referral notes.
user_story: As a sending HCP, I want to edit the priority of a referral and possibly its notes, so that the referral reflects the urgency.
technical_task: Let the sending HCP edit the priority of a referral and, optionally, the referral notes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a referral, when the sending HCP edits its priority, then the new priority is saved.
Given a referral, when the sending HCP edits the referral notes, then the notes are saved.
rationale: Role stated: sending HCP. "May" and "possibly" make the editing of notes optional.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view and update the details of an existing chemist/lab, with pincode remaining unchanged.
user_story: As a user, I want to view and update the details of an existing chemist or lab without changing its pincode, so that location data stays consistent.
technical_task: Allow viewing and updating of chemist/lab details while keeping the pincode fixed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing chemist or lab, when the user opens it, then its details are shown.
Given an existing chemist or lab, when the user updates its details, then the changes are saved and the pincode stays the same.

requirement_text: The system must be safely housed in a physically secure cabin.
user_story: As a facility manager, I want the system housed safely in a physically secure cabin, so that it is protected from tampering.
technical_task: Install the system in a cabin that is physically secure.
acceptance_criteria: Given the installed system, when its location is inspected, then it is in a cabin.
Given the cabin, when its security is reviewed, then it is physically secure.
rationale: Role assumed: facility manager. What makes the cabin "physically secure" is not defined.

requirement_text: Applicants' accessibility shall be ensured in all possible ways.
rationale: "In all possible ways" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What accessibility standard or measurable criteria apply for applicants?
What does "in all possible ways" cover?

requirement_text: Employers and recruiters shall be able to create multiple resume agents to receive daily emails matching their keywords.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want to create several resume agents that email me daily the resumes matching my keywords, so that I see new candidates each day.
technical_task: Allow employers and recruiters to create multiple resume agents, each sending a daily email of matching resumes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recruiter, when the recruiter creates resume agents with different keywords, then all agents are saved.
Given a resume agent, when the daily run happens, then an email with the resumes matching its keywords is sent.

requirement_text: The system shall allow browsing video thumbnails and segments.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to browse video thumbnails and segments, so that I can find a part of a video.
technical_task: Offer browsing of video thumbnails and video segments.
acceptance_criteria: Given videos, when the user browses, then video thumbnails are shown.
Given a video, when the user browses its segments, then the segments are shown.

requirement_text: In this context the entertainment sources radio, television, and optical drive are of special interest.
rationale: The sentence says which sources are of interest and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system do with the entertainment sources radio, television and optical drive?
Is this a requirement or an observation?

requirement_text: Each NE and flight cable assembly shall be identified by a part or type number and a unique serial number, consistent with the configuration management system and the specification for the contract.
requirement_text_raw: Each NE and flight cable assembly shall (3.2.4.2) be identified by a part or type number and a unique serial number, consistent with the configuration management system and the specification for the contract.
user_story: As a configuration manager, I want each NE and flight cable assembly identified by a part or type number and a unique serial number, so that it matches the configuration management system.
technical_task: Mark every NE and flight cable assembly with a part or type number and a unique serial number consistent with the configuration management system and the contract specification.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE or flight cable assembly, when it is inspected, then it carries a part or type number and a serial number.
Given two assemblies, when their serial numbers are compared, then they differ.

requirement_text: The LHCP views a list of requests he or she has made for reports with the status and pertinent information about the requests.
requirement_text_raw: The LHCP views a list of requests he or she has made for reports  with the status and pertinent information about the requests.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view a list of the report requests I made with their status and pertinent information, so that I can follow them.
technical_task: Display a list of the LHCP's report requests with their status and pertinent information.
acceptance_criteria: Given report requests made by an LHCP, when the LHCP opens the list, then the requests are shown with their status.
Given a request in the list, when it is displayed, then pertinent information about it is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view the application logo and affiliate logos upon startup.
user_story: As a user, I want to see the application logo and affiliate logos at startup, so that I know whose application it is.
technical_task: Display the application logo and the affiliate logos when the application starts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application starts, when the first screen is displayed, then the application logo is shown.
Given the application starts, when the first screen is displayed, then the affiliate logos are shown.

requirement_text: Camera hardware and image quality shall be chosen appropriately in order to be able to display objects at maximum range of the specified ODAs.
rationale: "Chosen appropriately" and the maximum range are not specified.
clarification_questions: What is the maximum range of the specified ODAs?
What image quality and camera hardware values count as "appropriate"?

requirement_text: The Proposer shall monitor the computing systems (24 by 7) and communications circuits to report and alert on compromised system health security availability and capacity.
requirement_text_raw: The Proposer shall monitor the computing systems (24 by 7) and communications circuits to report and alert on compromised system health  security  availability and capacity.
user_story: As a security manager, I want the computing systems and communications circuits monitored around the clock, with alerts on compromised health, security, availability and capacity, so that problems are noticed quickly.
technical_task: Monitor the computing systems and communications circuits continuously (24 by 7) and report and alert on compromised system health, security, availability and capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Given the computing systems and communications circuits, when they are in operation at any time (24 by 7), then they are monitored.
Given compromised system health, security, availability or capacity, when it is detected, then it is reported and an alert is raised.
rationale: Role assumed: security manager; the Proposer carries out the monitoring.

requirement_text: The product will be available for licensing as a one-server two-five servers or five-or-more servers license.
requirement_text_raw: The product will be available for licensing as a one-server  two-five servers  or five-or-more servers license.'
user_story: As a customer, I want the product offered with a one-server, two-five servers or five-or-more servers license, so that I can choose one that fits my setup.
technical_task: Offer three license options: one server, two to five servers, and five or more servers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the licensing options, when a customer views them, then a one-server license is available.
Given the licensing options, when a customer views them, then a two-five servers license and a five-or-more servers license are available.

requirement_text: Final 8D must be available incl. proposed changes not longer than 4 weeks.
user_story: As a client, I want the final 8D with proposed changes available within 4 weeks, so that corrective actions can start promptly.
technical_task: Deliver the final 8D report, including proposed changes, within 4 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a problem that requires an 8D, when 4 weeks have passed, then the final 8D including proposed changes is available.
Given an 8D delivered later than 4 weeks, when it is reviewed, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: client. The start of the 4 weeks is not stated.

requirement_text: Authorized personnel only, such as admins, shall access private data, and users shall only view their user page with valid credentials.
user_story: As an administrator, I want only authorized personnel such as admins to access private data and users to see only their own page with valid credentials, so that private data is protected.
technical_task: Restrict private data to authorized personnel and let users view only their own user page after authenticating with valid credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given authorized personnel such as an admin, when they request private data, then access is granted.
Given a user with valid credentials, when the user opens another user's page, then access is denied and only their own page is shown.

requirement_text: In all error cases, Support Services shall attempt to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path, switching back and forth between channels if necessary.
requirement_text_raw: In all error cases, Support Services shall [SRS222] attempt to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path, switching back and forth between channels if necessary.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path in all error cases, switching between channels if needed, so that communication continues.
technical_task: On any error, make Support Services select an error-free FCC-MPCC path and switch back and forth between channels when necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error case, when Support Services reacts, then it attempts to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path.
Given the current path is not error-free, when necessary, then Support Services switches between channels.

requirement_text: User shall filter rankings based on different criteria such as category or time period.
user_story: As a user, I want to filter rankings by criteria such as category or time period, so that I see the ranking I care about.
technical_task: Add filters for category and time period to the rankings view.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ranking, when the user filters by category, then only entries of that category are shown.
Given a ranking, when the user filters by time period, then only entries of that period are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means more criteria may exist.

requirement_text: Stockify shall achieve a two-second response time for user requests under normal load conditions.
user_story: As a user, I want Stockify to answer my requests within two seconds under normal load, so that it feels responsive.
technical_task: Keep Stockify's response time for user requests at two seconds under normal load.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal load conditions, when a user sends a request, then Stockify responds within two seconds.
Given a response that takes longer than two seconds under normal load, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Normal load" is not defined.

requirement_text: End of the game (see chapter 3.2.2.1) or menu selection.
rationale: The text is a fragment with no stated behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must happen at the end of the game or on menu selection?

requirement_text: User shall expect continuous system availability.
clarification_questions: What downtime, if any, is allowed?

requirement_text: Discrete outputs shall implement software controlled switches which when open (Off) result in a logical low signal level or when closed (On) results in a logical high signal level of the associated processor pins.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want discrete outputs to use software controlled switches giving a low level when open and a high level when closed, so that the processor pins show the output state.
technical_task: Implement discrete outputs as software controlled switches where open (Off) gives a logical low and closed (On) gives a logical high on the associated processor pins.
acceptance_criteria: Given a discrete output switch that is open (Off), when the processor pin is read, then it shows a logical low signal level.
Given a discrete output switch that is closed (On), when the processor pin is read, then it shows a logical high signal level.

requirement_text: Resumes will be hidden from specific companies.
user_story: As a job seeker, I want my resume hidden from specific companies, so that they cannot see it.
technical_task: Hide resumes from companies that are excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Given a resume hidden from a specific company, when that company searches resumes, then the resume is not shown.
Given a company that is not excluded, when it searches resumes, then the resume can be shown.

requirement_text: Preferred repair facility ratings should be saved within 5 seconds.
user_story: As a policyholder, I want my ratings of preferred repair facilities saved within 5 seconds, so that I don't have to wait.
technical_task: Save preferred repair facility ratings within 5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rating, when the user saves it, then it is saved within 5 seconds.
Given a save that takes longer than 5 seconds, when it is measured, then the recommendation is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: policyholder. "Should" makes the limit a recommendation.

requirement_text: User shall be able to download videos by clicking the download button and view them afterward.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to download videos with the download button and view them afterward, so that I can watch offline.
technical_task: Add a download button for videos and allow the downloaded videos to be viewed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video, when the user clicks the download button, then the video is downloaded.
Given a downloaded video, when the user opens it, then it can be viewed.

requirement_text: The patient chooses "My Expired Prescription Reports" and is presented with a list of the patient's expired prescriptions sorted by start date (the later date is ranked earlier closer to the top).
requirement_text_raw: The patient chooses "My Expired Prescription Reports" and is presented with a list of the patient's expired prescriptions   sorted by start date (the later date is ranked earlier closer to the top).
user_story: As a patient, I want to choose "My Expired Prescription Reports" and see my expired prescriptions sorted by start date with the later dates first, so that I can review them.
technical_task: Offer a "My Expired Prescription Reports" option that lists the patient's expired prescriptions sorted by start date, latest first.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with expired prescriptions, when the patient chooses "My Expired Prescription Reports", then the expired prescriptions are listed.
Given the list, when it is displayed, then prescriptions with later start dates appear closer to the top.

requirement_text: Remote access may be offered if agreed to by the organization subject to the aforementioned protocols and suitable authentication.
user_story: As an administrator, I want remote access offered when the organization agrees, subject to the protocols and suitable authentication, so that remote work is possible safely.
technical_task: Allow remote access if the organization has agreed, subject to the stated protocols and suitable authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Given the organization has agreed to remote access, when a user connects remotely with suitable authentication under the protocols, then access is granted.
Given the organization has not agreed or authentication is not suitable, when a user connects remotely, then access is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "May" makes the offer optional. The protocols are not listed.

requirement_text: Users shall set a secure password complying with password constraints.
user_story: As a user, I want to set a secure password that meets the password constraints, so that my account is protected.
technical_task: Enforce password constraints when users set a password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password that meets the constraints, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a password that does not meet the constraints, when the user sets it, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The constraints are not listed.

requirement_text: A fake email is sent to the LHCP alerting the user that a new message has arrived.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want an email alert that a new message has arrived, so that I know to check my messages.
technical_task: Send the LHCP an email alerting that a new message has arrived.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new message has arrived for an LHCP, when it is delivered, then an email alerting the LHCP is sent.
Given no new message, when time passes, then no alert email is sent.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. "Fake" is read as an alert email that does not contain the message itself, which is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The system shall allow administrators to delete any course/event.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to delete any course or event, so that outdated ones are removed.
technical_task: Allow administrators to delete any course or event.
acceptance_criteria: Given a course or event, when an administrator deletes it, then it is removed.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to delete a course or event, then it is not deleted.

requirement_text: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information when exchanged in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(2).
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want electronic health information encrypted and decrypted when exchanged according to the standard in 170.210(a)(2), so that exchanges are secure.
technical_task: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information at exchange using the standard specified in 170.210(a)(2).
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information to be exchanged, when it is sent, then it is encrypted in accordance with 170.210(a)(2).
Given encrypted electronic health information, when it is received, then it can be decrypted in accordance with the same standard.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: The maximum time-out value shall be 327.68 microseconds (256 counts of the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock which is 1.28 microseconds).
requirement_text_raw: The maximum time-out value shall (3.2.2.3.7) be 327.68 microseconds (256 counts of the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock which is 1.28 microseconds).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the maximum time-out value to be 327.68 microseconds, so that waiting is bounded.
technical_task: Set the maximum time-out to 327.68 microseconds, equal to 256 counts of the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock (1.28 microseconds).
acceptance_criteria: Given a time-out, when its value is set, then it does not exceed 327.68 microseconds.
Given the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock of 1.28 microseconds, when 256 counts are made, then they equal the maximum time-out value.

requirement_text: The system shall have a fast scanning and conversion speed to minimize user wait time.
user_story: As a user, I want fast scanning and conversion, so that I wait as little as possible.
technical_task: Optimize scanning and conversion to reduce user wait time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document to scan, when the user starts scanning, then scanning and conversion are performed.
Given scanning and conversion, when they run, then user wait time is kept as short as the system can achieve.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Fast" is not measured, so the criteria are qualitative.

requirement_text: The utility timer shall have an accuracy equal to or better than 50 PPM.
requirement_text_raw: The utility timer shall [SRS247] have an accuracy equal to or better than 50 PPM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the utility timer accuracy to be 50 PPM or better, so that timing is dependable.
technical_task: Give the utility timer an accuracy of 50 PPM or better.
acceptance_criteria: Given the utility timer, when its accuracy is measured, then it is equal to or better than 50 PPM.
Given an accuracy worse than 50 PPM, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Envelope depository shall meet specified dimensions.
rationale: The dimensions are referred to but not given.
clarification_questions: Which dimensions does "specified dimensions" refer to?

requirement_text: The product will require collaboration with a database management system (DBMS). The DBMS may be located on the same machine as the product or on a separate machine residing on the same computer network.
requirement_text_raw: The product will require collaboration with a database management system (DBMS).  The DBMS may be located on the same machine as the product or on a separate machine residing on the same computer network.'
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the product to work with a DBMS located on the same machine or on a separate machine on the same network, so that I can choose the deployment.
technical_task: Integrate the product with a database management system that is local or on another machine in the same computer network.
acceptance_criteria: Given a DBMS on the same machine as the product, when the product runs, then it collaborates with the DBMS.
Given a DBMS on a separate machine on the same computer network, when the product runs, then it collaborates with the DBMS.

requirement_text: Every maintenance team number shall be based on an association of: (M) service area identifier; type of maintenance team (speciality code); maintenance team identifier.
requirement_text_raw: 9.2.4.2 Every maintenance team number shall be based on an association of: (M) service area identifier; type of maintenance team (speciality code); maintenance team identifier.
user_story: As a railway operator, I want every maintenance team number built from the service area identifier, the maintenance team type (speciality code) and the maintenance team identifier, so that teams can be identified.
technical_task: Form each maintenance team number from a service area identifier, the type of maintenance team (speciality code) and a maintenance team identifier.
acceptance_criteria: Given a maintenance team, when its number is formed, then it contains the service area identifier.
Given a maintenance team, when its number is formed, then it also contains the type of maintenance team (speciality code) and the maintenance team identifier.

requirement_text: The system's reliability shall be primarily dependent on a continuously maintained and updated database backup that reflects the latest changes.
rationale: The sentence states a dependency and no testable target.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement that backups must be continuous, or a statement about reliability?

requirement_text: Both patients and LHCPs can view a list of their upcoming appointments .
user_story: As a patient, I want to view a list of my upcoming appointments, so that I know when to attend.
technical_task: Show patients and LHCPs a list of their upcoming appointments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient or LHCP with upcoming appointments, when the user opens the list, then the upcoming appointments are shown.
Given a past appointment, when the list is displayed, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: User shall receive a message for any successful or unsuccessful action performed.
user_story: As a user, I want a message for every successful or unsuccessful action, so that I know the result.
technical_task: Display a message after every action stating whether it succeeded or failed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an action that succeeds, when it completes, then a success message is shown.
Given an action that fails, when it ends, then a failure message is shown.
